## Summary
Daily autohealing convention-compliance scan found three docs source files still using `console.*` instead of `consola`, not covered by any existing open PR (#1886 and #1891 covered other files in this same cleanup effort).

- `docs/src/components/showcase/PropsTable.astro` — `console.warn` in Astro frontmatter (build-time)
- `docs/src/components/showcase/ComponentShowcase.astro` — `console.error` in client `<script>` block
- `docs/src/components/interactive/SimpleCodeEditor.astro` — `console.error` in client `<script type=\"module\">` block

`consola` is already a `@sparkle/docs` dependency and is already used client-side in `CodeHighlight.tsx`, confirming this is a safe, established pattern for both server (Astro frontmatter) and browser (`<script>`) contexts.

## Verification
- `pnpm --filter @sparkle/docs build` — passes, 71 pages built
- `pnpm check` — clean (0 errors, pre-existing unrelated markdown warnings only)
- Added changeset (`@sparkle/docs` patch), matching the pattern from #1886/#1891
